text:
anya: Quick sync — final decision points for GA acceptance. We need: concrete SLA numbers, support/oncall coverage, docs + runbook, monitoring dashboards, pricing tiering, and canary rollout plan. Who can call items?

mike: From eng: proposing P95 latency SLA 300ms for hosted API, 99.9% uptime monthly. Dedicated gets higher commitment (P95 200ms) but only after capacity validation.

samir: SRE note: uptime calc needs clear exclusion windows (maintenance), and we can't promise 99.9% P99 latency yet. Recommend SLOs (not SLA) for P99 until we have 2 weeks of production canaries.

leah: Ops: support coverage ask — GA needs 24/5 live support first week, then 24/7 for enterprise customers. Escalation playbook must include immediate oncall contact + runbook link.

olivia: Pricing ops: need price floor for Dedicated contracts + per-token pricing for hosted. Also define burst / overage behavior. Can we ship with 'intro GA pricing' flag? :thinking_face:

mike: +1 to intro flag. Also need automated fallback policies: if a model is overloaded, route to compatible lower-cost model. That must be documented in the API behavior docs.

anya: @samir okay to treat P99 as observability SLO for GA and commit P95 as contractual SLA?

samir: Yes — we can commit P95 SLA after smoke tests. Action: schedule 48h canary with real traffic shape.

deploy-bot: canary: started 1748504400 — variant: hosted-v2 -> 5% traffic, duration target: 48h. Logs -> https://internal.corp/canary/1748504400 :white_check_mark:

mike: Nice. Need runbook entries for rollback thresholds. Suggest: if error rate > 0.5% sustained for 10m OR P95 > 2x target for 5m -> rollback.

leah: I'll draft the runbook and escalate matrix. Will add contact table and routing for Customer Success handoffs.

olivia: For pricing, I'll propose 3 tiers: dev (free credits), standard (metered hosted), enterprise (reserved Dedicated + commitment). Will include overage rates and SLA-level add-ons.

anya: Docs: API behavior doc must call out: streaming semantics, function calls, fallback routing, eventual consistency for cache invalidation. Owner: mike for API text, leah for support integration.

samir: Monitoring: dashboards needed per-route P95/P99, error rates, token throughput, hot-turnaround. Alerting: page on P95 breach and sustained error rate.

anya: Okay owners and timeline: runbook + escalation (leah) — by EOD Tue. SLA wording + API docs (mike) — PR by Wed. Canary results (samir) — end of canary window Thu morning. Pricing proposal (olivia) — draft Wed. I'll consolidate and circulate a GA acceptance checklist Thurs afternoon.

mike: One more: we should include a note about allowed SLA exceptions (force majeure / planned maintenance) — legal to sign off.

leah: Adding legal + sales review step for exceptions.

anya: Great. If no blockers, we'll aim to flip GA flag after canary review. :thumbsup: Any last quick concerns?

olivia: Needs finance sign-off on billing meters — looping in finance after my draft.

samir: If canary shows KV cache regression, we pause. Noted.

anya: Thanks everyone — I'll follow up with a short checklist and assign PRs.
